title: The Blank Portraits
text: A long gallery of portraits in gilt frames, every one with no face, just a smooth blank where the face should be. As you walk past, one by one, they begin to paint themselves. The faces they paint are yours.

options.label: Each Scion stands and watches their own face appear, unable to look away.

outcomes.text: A flattering likeness, kinder than the truth, and they are glad of it.
A true likeness. It shows what they will look like when they are dead, and it is not long from now.

options.label: Each Scion slashes their portrait before it finishes. Some things should not be painted.

outcomes.text: Paint runs like blood across the floor, and the unfinished faces keep their mouths open, as if to scream.
